verdict.rationale: Versioned interfaces and a deprecation policy are a fair question for a scanner that ships a CLI and an MCP plugin. Nothing in the pack documents API versioning guarantees or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The only deprecation-related item is a community complaint that tfsec support was dropped abruptly, which points away from a documented policy rather than toward one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
